[b]Let's uncover the secrets of the wisps! 💫 [/b]

🎨 Save the villages from corruption
🧚‍♀️ Discover magical creatures 
📖 Document your journey with a notebook

🖌️ [b]What Wisper is about?[/b]
Wisper is set in a seemingly peaceful land, filled with various biomes, where people have lived since the beginning of the wisps. Explore a world influenced by their powers, meet unique people, and save them from the actions of a corrupted wisp.

Wisper [b]AVAILABLE NOW[/b] on [b]Steam[/b]! Play the game: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1707950/Wisper/
